scope: Original animation source evidence and coordinate conversion; no final adapted clips, Blockbench writes or combat changes.

coordinate_rules.reason: PSA key mirror is undone; UModel animation nonroot FixRotationKeys differs from unmodified BONENAMES refpose; glTF conjugates root and swaps Y/Z. Java applies proper 180-degree Y rotation.
coordinate_rules.psa_time: VQuatAnimKey.Time is 1 frame-unit for every key; seconds=f/AnimRate, not the stored Time=1 seconds.
coordinate_rules.psa_parent: Exporter placeholder, never used. 35 real bone parents resolved from same original mesh glTF; 2 unused tracks remain raw data only.

retarget_recommendation.rotation: D_world(t)=R_source_world(t)*inverse(R_source_reference_world); R_target_world(t)=D_world(t)*R_target_reference_world; R_target_local(t)=inverse(R_target_parent_world(t))*R_target_world(t). Use normalized quaternions/matrices and slerp, never add source Euler angles.
retarget_recommendation.translation: Preserve target rest bone offsets. Transform the source local-position delta through C_parent = inverse(R_target_parent_reference_world)*R_source_parent_reference_world, then add to target local rest. Apply any locomotion/foot-lock/amplitude choice as an explicit adaptation. Do not copy source absolute local positions.
retarget_recommendation.native_Euler: Convert the final target local rotation to the exact Blockbench Euler order; unwrap continuity; channel = solvedLocalEuler - nativeRestEuler. Subtraction is only the final serialization adapter, not the retarget operation.
retarget_recommendation.basis_choice: psaReferenceLocal/World is the USkeleton reference used by animation; restLocal/World is the exported mesh bind pose. Both supplied and errors reported. Shared 22 mapped names all have matching hierarchy. J_* joint bind frames coincide numerically, but geometry-marker bones Body/Head/R_Arm/R_Leg/L_Leg have different bind origins and sometimes orientations; never copy their absolute local poses.
retarget_recommendation.unadapted_clips: Walk still original hover locomotion; BasicAttack still original staff action; these source tracks are not mislabeled finished walking/spear-thrust animation.
